ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a large triangle ADE; A, B, C, and D are on the same horizontal base, and E is the vertex; from E, line segments EB and EC are drawn respectively to B and C on the base. In the small triangle ABE on the left, the angle at A is labeled x, the angle at E is labeled y, and the left-side angle at B is labeled z; at point B, z and m on the right side lie on opposite sides of the same straight base line, forming a straight angle. In the small triangle CDE on the right, the angle at D is labeled a, the angle at E is labeled b, and the right-side angle at C is labeled c; at point C, n on the left side and c on the right side lie on opposite sides of the same straight base line, forming a straight angle. Then reason: In triangle ABE, x + y + z = 180°. Because z + m = 180°, x + y = m. In triangle CDE, a + b + c = 180°. Because n + c = 180°, n = a + b. Adding the two equations gives x + y + n = m + a + b, that is, x + y + n = a + b + m.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle ADE with A, B, C, D collinear on the base, and segments EB and EC drawn from E. Use the left small triangle ABE: its angles are x at A, y at E, and z at B, so x + y + z = 180°. Since z and m form a straight angle at B on the base line, z + m = 180°, hence x + y = m. Use the right small triangle CDE: its angles are c at C, b at E, and a at D, so a + b + c = 180°. Since n and c form a straight angle at C, n + c = 180°, hence n = a + b. Add the two derived relations to get x + y + n = m + a + b, i.e. x + y + n = a + b + m.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个大三角形 ADE，A、B、C、D 在同一条水平底边上，E 是顶点；从 E 向底边上的 B、C 分别画出了线段 EB 和 EC。左侧小三角形 ABE 中，A 处角标为 x，E 处角标为 y，B 处靠左角标为 z；在 B 点，z 与右侧的 m 位于同一直线底边两侧，组成平角。右侧小三角形 CDE 中，D 处角标为 a，E 处角标为 b，C 处靠右角标为 c；在 C 点，左侧的 n 与右侧的 c 位于同一直线底边两侧，组成平角。再推理：在三角形 ABE 中，x + y + z = 180°。因为 z + m = 180°，所以 x + y = m。在三角形 CDE 中，a + b + c = 180°。因为 n + c = 180°，所以 n = a + b。把两式相加，得到 x + y + n = m + a + b，即 x + y + n = a + b + m。
method.model_answer: Final answer: $x + y + n = a + b + m$
